major functions of the Evacuee Trust Property Board is to manage religious places belonging to Sikhs and Hindus and facilitate Sikh / Hindu Yatrees on their religious festivals as laid down in Sec.4(2) (i) of the Act 1975. Functions of Shrines Branch: To look after historical functional shrines of Sikhs and Hindus including their management. Provision of facilities to the Sikh and Hindu pilgrims who visit Pakistan to perform their religious rituals /rites To deal with the affairs of Pakistan Sikh Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (PSGPC). Festivals/Occasions: As per bilateral “Protocol on Visits to Religious Shrines- 1947” between India and Pakistan, Sikhs and Hindus are allowed to visit Pakistan on following occasions:- Sikh Festivals/Occasions No. Name of Festival / Place of Main Ceremony No of Pilgrims allowed Duration of Stay 1 Baisakhi Festival-Gurdwaras Punja Sahib, Hassanabdal 3000 10 Days (April) 2 Martyrdom Day of Guru Arjun Dev Jee – Lahore 1000 10 Days (June) 3 Death Anniversary of Maharaja Ramjeet Singh – Lahore 500 10 Days (June) 4 Birthday Celebrations of Guru Nanak Dev Jee – Nankana Sahib 3000 10 Days (November) Hindu Yatrees No. Name of Festival / Place of Main Ceremony No of Pilgrims allowed Duration of Stay 1 Katas Raj Temple District Chakwal 200 5 Days (Feb/Mar) 2 Shadami Darbar, Hayat Pitafi, Mirpur Mathelo 400 10 Days (Nov/Dec) 3 Katas Raj Temples, District Chakwal 200 5 Days (Oct) Reception / Langar Reception at Wagha Railway Station. Provision of Langar on Arrival/departure and during stay of Yatrees in Pakistan. Travel Arrangements Arrangements of special trains for Sikh/Hindu Yatrees to cities where all major Gurdwaras/Mandirs are situated. Customs and Immigration Liaison with customers and immigration/Rangers authorities for speedy immigration clearance of Yatrees. Security Adequate security arrangements in consultation with concerned departments for the protection of Gurdwaras/Mandirs and Yatrees. Accommodation Comfortable boarding and lodging arrangements for Yatrees within the premises of major Gurdwaras/Mandirs and alternative places as well. Rituals To ensure holding of religious ceremonies in Gurdwaras/Mandirs as per traditions of Sikh & Hindu religions. Currency Exchange Arrangements of money exchange counters of National Bank of Pakistan/Habib Bank Limited at Wagha Railway Station and in all major Gurdwaras. Telephone Facilities PTC telephone booths with NWD/ISD facilities in all main Gurdwaras. Health Cover Round the clock availability of doctors/para medical staff for Yatrees during the travel of Yatrees and their stay at Gurdwaras/Mandirs.
